description_en: Retrieves the access log status for a specified cloud connector
description_zh: 获取指定云连接器访问日志状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc get-iot-cloud-connector-access-log --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIoTCloudConnectorAccessLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate this value on the client side. It must be unique across requests and contain no more than 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request may have a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specify whether to perform only a dry run of this request. Valid values:

true: Submit a dry-run request. The system does not return access log status information. Instead, it checks required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error code. If the check passes, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.

false (default): Submit a normal request. After passing the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and the access log status information
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会获取访问日志状态信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接获取访问日志状态信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AccessLogSlsLogStore.description_en: The Logstore that receives access logs
AccessLogSlsLogStore.description_zh: 访问日志投递的日志库

AccessLogSlsProject.description_en: The Log Service project that receives access logs
AccessLogSlsProject.description_zh: 访问日志投递的日志项目

AccessLogStatus.description_en:
The status of access logging. Valid values:

Opening: Enabling access logging.

Opened: Access logging is enabled.

Closed: Access logging is disabled.

Closing: Disabling access logging
AccessLogStatus.description_zh:
访问日志的状态，取值：
Opening：开启中。
Opened：已开启。
Closed：已关闭。
Closing：关闭中
